## 1. Start
The button on the control page calls the webhook (POST /webhook/check-new-products).
The schedule runs the same steps every morning.
Optional body: {"limit": 3, "collection": "chair"}
Empty source = scraper default (demo supplier).

## 2. Scrape + duplicate check
The scraper container returns the products. We compare each product URL with the URLs already in the Google Sheet and only add new ones (status "Neu").
Cell format RAW keeps prices like 5750.00 as typed (a German sheet would otherwise read the dot as a thousands separator).

## 3. Translate + save
One OpenAI request per product (1 s pause between requests). Success -> German texts + status "Wartet auf Freigabe". Error -> status "Fehler" + reason in the error column. The row is found by its id.
